choices.scene: A ferry-terminal cargo office before dawn; an investigator documents pry marks on the low exterior latch while the duty clerk holds the office door steady.
A municipal greenhouse service entrance after rain; an investigator measures a fresh shoe impression in spilled potting soil while the groundskeeper waits by the open door.
A closed neighborhood cinema after the last show; an investigator photographs a forced cash-room door while the night manager watches from the corridor.
An archive loading bay early morning; an investigator examines a cut security seal on a shipment while the receiving clerk keeps the trolley still.
